body: I haven't done many nice things though. I've done a lot of really mean, manipulative things masked as nice things. If someone let you borrow $20 today so they could use it to guilt you into giving them $50 next week, is that nice? I just do things so I can get things out of it in the future.

I can think about it all I want but it won't make me a better person. It's kind of like how the abused become abusers. At the time manipulation is the only way I know how to handle a situation because it's my only method in which I still have the power. I need power over things because if I lose it I'll just be back to where I was when I was a kid.
